name: ruic-card
description: Holographic collectible-card generator: layered artwork + Blender + Three.js, in two routes - paint the four layers from a description or reference image, or derive them from a photo you already have (rembg cutout, optional watermark removal, animation render and MP4 / WeChat-sized GIF deliverables). Outputs an interactive parallax card website plus an editable card.blend project.

description_i18n.en: Holographic collectible-card generator: layered artwork + Blender + Three.js, in two routes - paint the four layers from a description or reference image, or derive them from a photo you already have (rembg cutout, optional watermark removal, animation render and MP4 / WeChat-sized GIF deliverables). Outputs an interactive parallax card website plus an editable card.blend project.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 全息闪卡生成器：分层画稿 + Blender + Three.js，两条路线——用描述或参考图绘制四层图，或直接把已有照片切成四层（rembg 抠图、可选去水印，附动画渲染与 MP4 / 微信动图交付）。产出可交互的 3D 视差闪卡网页与可编辑的 card.blend 工程。
